headline: Two probes were crying wolf — one said a clean closeout was debt, the other called an on-time cron silent. Both fixed, and the offline path members opt into is now gated in a real browser.

items.title: A cron line with a comment was invisible to the staleness probe
items.insight: The cron pattern was anchored at end-of-line, so any `- cron: '0 6 * * 1'  # Monday` matched nothing and the workflow silently became 'daily'. 11 lines in 9 workflows. Separate cron lines now combine by rate, so four daily Desk slots are one run every 6h, not one a day.
items.evidence: self-test 28/28 with the verbatim workflow text; live 14 workflows checked, 0 silent (was 1 false silent)

items.title: Write-back currency classifies PROJECT_STATUS by key, not by file
items.insight: PROJECT_STATUS.json is written by hand and by tools, and the post-closeout resync rewrites doctorScore in it, so every resync looked like un-written-back work. Keys are surveyed from 40 real commits; an unreadable diff stays debt, so the rule can only over-report.
items.evidence: self-test 20/20 pinning df79cc6b (churn) and 20e0dd4b2 (still substantive); live: current

items.title: A browser gate installs the service worker
items.insight: No gate had ever run register('/sw.js'), which is how an uninstallable worker survived three months in production. The new spec requires `activated` and a complete precache, and blocks the E2E compliance job.
items.evidence: mutation-tested: a 404 precache entry turns the worker redundant and the spec red; passes on local preview, staging and production

items.title: The unarmed newsletter cron holds instead of failing
items.insight: Six red scheduled runs a year, all from a deliberate non-arming, are indistinguishable from a cron that broke. The schedule now emits a held annotation and exits 0 unless NEWSLETTER_ARMED=true. Nothing was armed and nothing was sent.
items.evidence: .github/workflows/member-newsletter.yml; the staleness probe already reports held publishers by name (S355)

items.title: The precache is reviewed and kept, with numbers
items.insight: 100 entries, 3.2 MB raw / about 779 KB brotli, fetched in the background only for members who turn on offline and push. No trim is justified by those numbers.
items.evidence: measured per entry from the served files; D-S362.5
